title: Microservices Decomposition by Business Capability
description: A microservices decomposition architecture diagram organized by business capabilities: Identity, Product Catalog, Pricing, and Order Fulfillment, each with independent data stores and APIs. This template shows how to break a monolith into services aligned with business domains, using a Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) pattern for client-specific aggregation. Useful for architects planning domain-driven microservice boundaries.
